tokens.name: paper-100
tokens.usage: Page and panel background: notebook paper by day, chalkboard by night.

tokens.name: paper-50
tokens.usage: Raised cards, menus and dialogs that sit on paper-100.

tokens.name: desk-200
tokens.usage: Sunken wells, the HUD tray and inactive tabs: the wooden desk under the paper.

tokens.name: rule-300
tokens.usage: Notebook-rule hairlines, dividers and empty stat-bar tracks. Decorative only, never text.

tokens.name: margin-red
tokens.usage: The single vertical margin line on ruled panels. Decorative only.

tokens.name: ink-900
tokens.usage: Primary text and icon colour on paper-100, paper-50 and desk-200 (11:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-600
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, stat labels on paper-100 and paper-50 (6:1 or more).

tokens.name: graphite
tokens.usage: Fixed dark ink that never flips: text and icons on pencil, cardboard and eraser fills in both themes (5.8:1 or more).

tokens.name: pencil-400
tokens.usage: Brand yellow. Primary buttons, the paper counter, selected states. Always with graphite text.

tokens.name: pencil-600
tokens.usage: Pencil edge: the hard bottom shadow under pencil-400 buttons and the pressed state.

tokens.name: cardboard-400
tokens.usage: Cardboard fill for bases, buildings and build slots. Graphite text on it; not a text colour on paper in light theme (2.5:1).

tokens.name: cardboard-700
tokens.usage: Cardboard text and borders on paper: costs, building names, slot outlines (6.4:1 light, 7.8:1 dark).

tokens.name: eraser-300
tokens.usage: Playful accent: new badges, rewards, the crumple flash. Graphite text on it.

tokens.name: sticky-200
tokens.usage: Sticky-note paper for CoachMark hints: a softer yellow than pencil-400. Graphite text on it (10.8:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: tape-100
tokens.usage: The strip of tape that holds a sticky note on. Decorative only.

tokens.name: sky-500
tokens.usage: Friendly and info: your planes, radar sweep, links, focus rings (4.7:1 light, 6.7:1 dark on paper).

tokens.name: raid-500
tokens.usage: Danger: incoming raids, enemy planes, losses, destructive actions (4.8:1 light, 6.0:1 dark on paper).

tokens.name: win-500
tokens.usage: Success: mission complete, reward collected, base secured (5.0:1 light, 7.8:1 dark on paper).

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text on sky-500, raid-500 and win-500 fills; flips with the theme so it keeps 4.5:1.

tokens.name: team-1
tokens.usage: Team colour 1 (Red). Plane trim, desk flag, minimap dot.

tokens.name: team-2
tokens.usage: Team colour 2 (Blue).

tokens.name: team-3
tokens.usage: Team colour 3 (Yellow).

tokens.name: team-4
tokens.usage: Team colour 4 (Green).

tokens.name: team-5
tokens.usage: Team colour 5 (Purple).

tokens.name: team-6
tokens.usage: Team colour 6 (Orange).

tokens.name: team-7
tokens.usage: Team colour 7 (Teal).

tokens.name: team-8
tokens.usage: Team colour 8 (Pink). Teams 1, 2, 4 and 5 sit close in lightness: always pair a team colour with its desk number or crest pattern, never hue alone.

families.display: "Lilita One", "Arial Rounded MT Bold", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Title screen, victory and defeat banners. One per screen.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Screen titles and big event callouts.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card titles, plane and building names, dialog headings.

styles.name: counter
styles.usage: HUD numbers: paper, timers, scores. Use tabular figures where the font allows.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Scout an enemy desk and come home with the map.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Button labels, tabs, stat names. Set in uppercase.

styles.name: doodle
styles.usage: Tutorial hints, coach marks and margin notes, as if scribbled by a classmate. Never for numbers or controls.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, stat-bar segments.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside chips and counters; button vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked rows in a card.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, button horizontal padding, HUD edge inset.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in the build grid; dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Notebook rule pitch on ruled panels; section gaps.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Screen margins on menus and the title screen.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, stat bars, small inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, build slots, cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs, the HUD tray, raid alerts.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Counters, team chips, toggles.

shadow.note: Hard, offset, no blur: things look like stacked paper and cardboard, not glass.

tokens.name: shadow-press
tokens.usage: Under pencil-400 buttons; drops to 0 1px 0 when pressed.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Under paper-50 cards: a sheet lifted off the desk.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Dragged items, open dialogs, the selected plane.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: Notebook rules and dividers.

tokens.name: stroke-line
tokens.usage: Card, button and slot outlines: the drawn-with-a-marker edge.

tokens.name: stroke-focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard and controller focus ring, in sky-500, 2px offset.
